title: Dollars In, Bitcoin Out: Breez SDK Debuts New Stablecoin Feature
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Dollars In, Bitcoin Out: Breez SDK Debuts New Stablecoin Feature Despite being so-called digital dollars, stablecoins aren’t always simple to use.
